title: Lapse Blue (SBL Plyometrics & Mobility)
author: Zayaan A.
desc:
this program is intended to be done alongside my hypertrophy plan, reversel red (fbeod). Can be done standalone but should be done with some form of hypertrophy work ideally.

the plan should (ideally) be repeated as follows, with a rest day inbetween each, alternating from A to B
- A:
  - AM: FBEOD (Lower Bias)
  - PM: Mobility -> Zone 2 Cardio
- B:
  - AM: FBEOD (Upper Bias)
  - PM: Plyo -> Zone 2 Cardio

Plyometrics work chosen are done to try and allow an avenue for progressive overloadability that isnt weight used (as this aspect is covered by box squts / walking lunges in reversal red). Mobility work is chosen with a focus on correcting primarily hip and ankle mobility, alongside overpronation. change, drop, or adjust any of the mobility exercises if so wished, ... but i think the plyometrics are optimal and so shouldnt be changed.

Boostcamp Specific Notes:
- Translate RPE instead to RiR, ie RPE10 = 0RiR, RPE9 = 1RiR, ...
- 0 RiR is not failure, but wherein the next rep would fail

Cardio:
- Should be scheduled as far after hypertrophy training as possible, but on the same days as training - to prevent interference with recovery
- it is worth timing ~0.8g/kg/hr carbs ~1hr before
- the intention is for 20-30mins of zone2 cardio to be done in the evenings of the training day, but that can be entirely varied (or omitted) based on individual circumstance


Useful Resources:
- Discussion on volume, with authors of primary dose-response relationship meta analyses alongside jeff nippard
  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lbE-WU--Qp0
- Comprehensive reading on micronutrition, consequences, and sources
  https://lpi.oregonstate.edu/mic
- Plyometrics work based partly on the work of dr john rusin
